events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Julius Peppers returned an interception 49 yards for a touchdown, Aaron Rodgers threw for three scores, and the Green Bay Packers routed the Minnesota Vikings 42-10 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers strike early, cruise to rout of Vikings

headlines.description: Dan Bailey kicked a 49-yard field goal in overtime after a miss at the end of regulation ended his franchise record streak of made kicks, and the Dallas Cowboys beat the Houston Texans 20-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bailey's FG lifts surging Cowboys to OT win

headlines.description: Bills beat Lions on 58-yard field goal
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills cap comeback over Lions with 58-yd FG

headlines.description: Brian Hoyer threw a 6-yard touchdown pass to Travis Benjamin with 1:09 left, and the Cleveland Browns rallied from a 25-point deficit in beating the Tennessee Titans 29-28 Sunday for their first road win in more than a year.
headlines.shortLinkText: Browns rally from 25-point deficit, stun Titans

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Khiry Robinson's tackle-breaking, 18-yard touchdown run in overtime lifted the New Orleans Saints to a 37-31 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robinson, Saints rumble to OT win over Bucs

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at New York Giants

headlines.description: First-round draft pick Odell Beckham Jr. made his NFL debut a memorable one, catching a go-ahead 15-yard touchdown pass from Eli Manning with 10:02 left to lead the New York Giants to a 30-20 victory over the Atlanta Falcons on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beckham catches TD in debut as Giants rally

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: Eagles beat Rams behind defense, special teams
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles beat Rams behind defense, special teams

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw two touchdown passes to Greg Olsen and the Carolina Panthers' defense forced four turnovers to overcome a 14-point deficit and defeat the Chicago Bears 31-24 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Panthers rally past TO-prone Bears

headlines.description: Steelers D comes up big in 17-9 win over Jaguars
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers D comes up big in 17-9 win over Jaguars

headlines.description: Manning's 500th TD leads Broncos past Cards 41-20
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning's 500th TD leads Broncos past Cards

events.name: New York Jets at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Rivers, Chargers race past hapless Jets, 31-0
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers, Chargers race past hapless Jets, 31-0

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick threw for 201 yards and a touchdown, Frank Gore ran for 107 yards and the San Francisco 49ers converted a fake punt to beat the Kansas City Chiefs 22-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fake punt helps Niners beat Smith, Chiefs

events.name: Cincinnati Bengals at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady became the sixth quarterback to throw for 50,000 career yards when he hit Rob Gronkowski on a 27-yard pass in the first quarter of the Patriots' game against the Bengals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady, Patriots rebound by pounding Bengals

headlines.description: Russell Wilson rushed for a career-high 122 yards and a touchdown Monday night, and the Seattle Seahawks overcame more than a dozen penalties in a 27-17 victory over the Washington Redskins.
